note: View-independent metric (people per m^2 on the Mataf floor, edge/m2_pipeline.py). Since 2026-10-26 ~19:05 Makkah it is produced by the live shot service (scripts/live_shot.py, every 1-2 s, any shot: calibrated cameras, registration against the panorama bank, tracking, prayer rows); 'enabled' is the crowd collector's own m2 path, off since then (it ran every 15 s from 2026-10-24 ~23:05). Read at start. kaaba_fit: also fit a free camera to the Kaaba's silhouette (off). anchor: fit rotation + focal length at the calibrated positions when the Kaaba is in view. trace_memory: tracemalloc diagnostics in the crowd collector.

sba.note: SBA's 720p stream (fallback only) finds fewer people than YouTube 1080p: ring 'all' 0.82 of YouTube on 61 simultaneous same-camera pairs (55 cam0_mataf_low, 6 cam1_mataf_wide); this curve brings it to 1.05 (p10-p90 0.69-1.21). Applied by user decision 2026-10-27; SBA readings then join the main series (edge/m2_pipeline.g_for, scripts/live_shot.db_source).

correction.note: Live correction (edge/m2_metric.load_correction): corrected = raw / (max(g(head px), 0.2) x camera_factor). g = 1 - exp(-(h/h0)^k), the share of people DM-Count finds at head width h, fitted on 7,185 same-camera zoom pairs (scripts/zoom_calib.py). Absolute level from ground truth (2026-10-26, prayer rows: row spacing x spacing in the row, scripts/rows_truth.py, scripts/gt_compare.py): at 9-12 px heads raw DM-Count is within 0.5-1.17x of it, so the low and wide cameras get no factor; the roof reads 1.5x them on the same floor after g (same-floor sector pairs), so its readings are divided by 1.5 (DM-Count on 3x tiles gives the same roof level). Prayer rows on the roof: edge/prayer_rows.py. Before: h0 6.5, k 1.2, no factors. cam8_roof_b (calibrated 2026-10-26 from saved Maghrib frames: 158 m out, 77 m up, heads 3-4 px like the roof): 1.5 like the roof, provisional until its same-floor sector pairs (scripts/zoom_calib.py) confirm it.

shadow.note: v3 as the shadow next to live v4 + fixes (user 2026-10-30: before / after on the same frames, crowd_m2_shadow). Turn off when the comparison is done.

live_model.note: The Mataf metric's model: 'use' picks live_model_<use> (one setting to switch back: "use": "v3", then stop.bat / start.bat). edge/m2_metric.live_model_config merges it.

live_model_v3.note: v3 (models/DM-Count_QNRF_ft3.pth), live 2026-10-29 01:46:54 to 2026-10-30; SBA curve and approximate table refitted for it (scripts/shadow_refit.py --weights qnrf_ft3).

live_model_v4.note: v4 (models/DM-Count_QNRF_v4.pth, prayer rows, live DVR + recordings) with edge/m2_fill.py's fixes: within 4 m of the walls max(v4, v3 on a crop around the Kaaba); during prayer the inner ring directly behind the Kaaba from the near side when it reads under 0.8x, and 'stopped_rows_m2' (0 = off): stopped speed sectors where v4 sees people read at least that (1.2, fitted to the rows labels on 31 Oct's saved 1 s prayer pairs). 'source' (SBA head-size curve) and 'approx' are v3's until refitted for v4 (scripts/shadow_refit.py --weights qnrf_v4 --section live_model_v4). 'speed': the tawaf speed sensor (edge/tawaf_speed.py) gives walking ring sectors their density. 'save_prayer_pairs': its 1 s pairs from prayer windows saved to data/samples/speed_pairs (offline tests; not deleted automatically).

live_model_v4_candidate.note: v4's own SBA head-size curve and approximate table (scripts/shadow_refit.py --weights qnrf_v4 --section live_model_v4_candidate, 2026-11-01, 88 YouTube/SBA pairs of data/samples/dual2). NOT in use: live_model_v4 still carries v3's curve. To switch: copy "source" and "approx" into live_model_v4 (or set live_model "use" to "v4_candidate" with "fixes", "speed" and "weights" copied in), then stop.bat / start.bat.
